about.headline: Excellence Served Since Day One
about.text: Chef-Chi Catering Service Luxembourg delivers unforgettable culinary experiences.

menu.name: Pepper Chicken
menu.desc: Spicy, flavorful chicken marinated in a blend of peppers and spices, grilled to perfection.

menu.name: Pepper Turkey
menu.desc: Spicy, flavorful turkey marinated in a blend of peppers and spices, grilled to perfection.

menu.name: Porridge Plantain
menu.desc: A traditional Nigerian dish made with plantain and a rich, flavorful broth.

menu.name: White Rice + Stew (tomato or ayamase)
menu.desc: Fluffy white rice served with your choice of rich tomato stew or spicy ayamase pepper sauce, accompanied by premium sides.

menu.name: Meat pie
menu.desc: Flaky pastry filled with savory spiced meat, served with a side of tangy dipping sauce.

menu.name: Egusi Soup
menu.desc: A traditional Nigerian soup made with ground melon seeds, leafy greens, and a rich, flavorful broth.

menu.name: Oha Soup
menu.desc: A traditional Nigerian soup made with oha leaves and a rich, flavorful broth.

menu.name: Fisherman Soup
menu.desc: A traditional Nigerian soup made with a variety of seafood and a rich, flavorful broth

menu.name: Ogbono Soup
menu.desc: A traditional Nigerian soup made with ogbono seeds and a rich, flavorful broth.

menu.name: Vegetable soup
menu.desc: A traditional Nigerian soup made with a variety of vegetables and a rich, flavorful broth

menu.name: Porridge Yam
menu.desc: A traditional Nigerian dish made with yam and a rich, flavorful broth

menu.name: Grilled Fish
menu.desc: A well prepared grilled fish with a rich, flavorful broth.

menu.name: Ugba
menu.desc: A traditional Nigerian dish made with oil bean seeds and a rich, flavorful broth

menu.name: Ukwa
menu.desc: A traditional Nigerian dish made with breadfruit seeds and a rich, flavorful broth

menu.name: Fish rolls
menu.desc: Crispy rolls filled with seasoned fish, served with a tangy dipping sauce.

menu.name: Puffs
menu.desc: Flaky pastry filled with savory spiced meat, served with a side of tangy dipping sauce.

menu.name: Buns
menu.desc: Soft, sweet buns filled with a savory spiced meat mixture, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.

menu.name: Zobo Drinks
menu.desc: A refreshing Nigerian drink made from hibiscus petals, served chilled with a hint of ginger and citrus.

menu.name: Tiger Nut Drinks
menu.desc: A creamy, nutty beverage made from tiger nuts, served chilled for a refreshing treat.

menu.name: Creamy vanilla ice cream
menu.desc: Rich and creamy vanilla ice cream made with premium ingredients, perfect for a luxurious dessert experience.

menu.name: Akara
menu.desc: Crispy fried bean cakes made from black-eyed peas, seasoned with onions and spices, served with a spicy dipping sauce.

menu.name: Moi moi
menu.desc: Steamed bean pudding made from black-eyed peas, blended with onions, peppers, and spices, wrapped in banana leaves for a flavorful and moist dish.

menu.name: Shawarma
menu.desc: Thinly sliced marinated meat (chicken or beef) cooked on a vertical rotisserie, served in warm pita bread with fresh vegetables and a drizzle of creamy garlic sauce.
